ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels comprise >90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scarring and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Monolithic low-intensity black region spanning both lobes; secondary high-intensity clusters are distributed as discrete points and linear segments primarily across the medial and distal sections of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 45 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the full trailing edge; prominent macroscopic indentation located on the distal-most edge of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curve on the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe displays a more linear, tapered sweep toward the terminal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel radius) concentrated on the central-left fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned white linear pixel paths ranging from 10 to 80 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue segment on the distal-lateral edge of the left lobe.
